metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the CLI in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py), with usage and format details in [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md).

```sh
python output/main.py --input request.json --output response.json
```

The tool supports all four actions, structured errors, GEDCOM validation and round trips, and GEDZIP attachment checks. It uses only the Python standard library.

Verification passed: compilation and 18 end-to-end tests.

The request format has no password field for encrypted GEDZIPs. It also cannot distinguish an undocumented extension’s literal text such as `@I1@` from a pointer with the same value; rendering treats that ambiguous value as a pointer.

editorial.last_message: Claims a stdlib-only Python GEDCOM tool (output/main.py, README) supporting all four actions, structured errors, validation, round trips and GEDZIP attachment checks; compilation and 18 end-to-end tests pass. Notes two contract gaps: no password field for encrypted GEDZIPs, and an undocumented extension's literal '@I1@' text is rendered as a pointer. Not a false completion claim.
